d: Sheikh Hasina says no threat of death will stop her from returning to Bangladesh. Dhaka says it is ready to receive her. But there is one country caught in the middle: India. With Hasina facing a death sentence in absentia, reports suggest India wants security guarantees and assurances of due process before any move is made. So, what does Hasina want, what is Bangladesh demanding, and what is India weighing? Palki Sharma tells you.
